title: Brightwave Media
summary: A WordPress 6 / MariaDB company blog: the admin account has a wordlist-weak password that wp-login.php accepts, the authenticated Theme/Plugin editor turns into a PHP webshell, and the wp_users table leaks phpass hashes that crack offline to the same weak password.

loot.description: the WordPress admin account email in wp_users (proves the users table seeded)
phpass portable hashes in wp_users (random salt, so fingerprint the $P$ prefix; crack with john --format=phpass)
the WordPress DB password, recoverable from the app container's environment (e.g. after RCE)
